contract: class Optimizer: __init__(self, budget, dim, n_obj); __call__(self, problem, bounds) evaluates problem(x) -> objectives (minimize all) at most budget times. Score: hypervolume of the evaluated points normalized by the known Pareto front's hypervolume
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
